annotations.text:
HOMEPAGE — dark by default
One direction, two modes: the nav carries a sun/moon toggle and the light twin is the artboard to the right.
This revision: deeper charcoal (#0C1217, down from the soft #11191E), the marquee band removed entirely, and no orange buttons anywhere — orange is now only section numbers, the rarity bars, the life-list ticks and a few hairlines.
Sections 05, 06, 07 and 08 are new ideas, not things the site does today — they are labelled "new idea" on the page so nothing reads as a promise.

HOMEPAGE — light mode
The same page and the same components with the light theme applied. The rarity bars use a separate validated orange ramp, because the dark ramp would wash out on white.

Three bolder explorations, parked here rather than deleted.
Worth raiding for parts even though the homepage went a different way — the engraved index, the gapless contact sheet and the graded slabs would all drop into the main page.
